# Vendored libraries

Kept in the repository rather than fetched at runtime, because the content
security policy on the read-only API allows scripts from `self` only, and the
demo has to run with the network off.

| File | Version | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `three.module.js` | three.js r169 | MIT |

Fonts in `../fonts/` are Instrument Serif and Geist, both under the SIL Open
Font Licence, taken from the Fontsource packages at version 5.2.5.
